hints.tr: Saniyede 50 istek × 0,01 saniye = 0,5: sunucu zamanın yarısında meşgul.
hints.en: 50 requests per second × 0.01 seconds = 0.5: the server is busy half of the time.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def utilization(rate, service_ms, workers):
    return round(rate * service_ms / 1000 / workers, 3)


print(utilization(50, 10, 1))
print(utilization(120, 10, 2))
print(utilization(30, 45, 4))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def utilization(rate, service_ms, workers):
    return round(rate * service_ms / 1000 / workers, 3)


print(utilization(50, 10, 1))
print(utilization(120, 10, 2))
print(utilization(30, 45, 4))
```
